fields.name: 7ipiq3qdpm
fields.label: Patrol
fields.description: The patrol this report covers. Matches the `patrol` tag on the Patrol GPS Log rows the guard's device uploaded. One report per patrol — file it at any point during or after the patrol.

fields.name: 7iphrdgu5e
fields.label: Report Type
fields.description: Routine is a normal patrol observation. Incident flags something needing follow-up and unlocks the incident details below.

fields.name: 7ipj3gviuh
fields.label: Shift Assignment
fields.description: The Shift Planning entry covering this patrol. Resolved automatically from the guard and the patrol window; farm and personel are read from it.

fields.name: 7ipkjo3hob
fields.label: Started At
fields.description: First/last GPS fix recorded for this patrol.

fields.name: 7ipqkrrcpu
fields.label: Ended At
fields.description: First/last GPS fix recorded for this patrol.

fields.name: 7ipbh8cf85
fields.label: GPS Points Logged
fields.description: GPS points uploaded for this patrol. Filled in automatically.

fields.name: 7ip96tomi3
fields.label: Filed At
fields.description: When the guard submitted this report. Set automatically.

fields.name: 7ipnuqhaqj
fields.label: Observations
fields.description: What the guard saw on this patrol — incidents, hazards, gates left open, anything the supervisor should know.

fields.name: 7ipblndip2
fields.label: Nature of Incident
fields.options:
Accident
Fire
Intrusion
Medical Emergency
Near Miss
Other
Property Damage
Robbery With Violence
SOS
Theft
fields.description: Carried into the Incident Report, which requires it.

fields.name: 7ipmbmcrnm
fields.label: Incident Report
fields.description: The Incident Report raised automatically when this was flagged. Editing observations here does not rewrite it.

fields.name: 7ip5hgiov3
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Set to Submitted when the guard files. Only Security Head can move it to Reviewed or Flagged.

fields.name: 7ipt41kpt9
fields.label: Reviewed By
fields.description: Stamped automatically when the status moves off Submitted.
